evals.name: explicit-complete-table-overrides-default-cap
evals.prompt: Read config/delivery_policies.yml and produce one complete table with one row for every configured policy, preserving file order. Include the exact name, attempts, delay_ms, timeout_ms, and full purpose text verbatim for every row. Do not shorten or group the purpose text. Include a code location for each row.
evals.actor_context: Synthetic current repository at /work/auth-demo. config/delivery_policies.yml is available on disk; its contents have not been read in this session.

files.config/delivery_policies.yml:
policies:
  - name: mail_receipt
    attempts: 3
    delay_ms: 100
    timeout_ms: 1000
    purpose: Retry transient receipt delivery failures while keeping each receipt attempt short enough that the checkout confirmation path can recover promptly during downstream mail disruptions.
  - name: mail_digest
    attempts: 5
    delay_ms: 300
    timeout_ms: 5000
    purpose: Allow digest delivery several recovery attempts because digest content is useful for a longer period and a brief delay rarely changes the recipient experience.
  - name: webhook_order
    attempts: 4
    delay_ms: 200
    timeout_ms: 2000
    purpose: Retry order notifications with bounded waiting so a temporary receiver outage can recover without leaving the delivery worker occupied for an unbounded amount of time.
  - name: webhook_stock
    attempts: 2
    delay_ms: 50
    timeout_ms: 500
    purpose: Limit stock notification retries because newer inventory updates quickly replace older values and stale delivery work should not dominate the notification processing queue.
  - name: export_small
    attempts: 3
    delay_ms: 250
    timeout_ms: 4000
    purpose: Retry small export jobs when transient storage failures occur while keeping a moderate timeout that prevents one missing storage response from blocking the worker indefinitely.
  - name: export_large
    attempts: 6
    delay_ms: 500
    timeout_ms: 20000
    purpose: Give large export uploads longer attempts and additional retries because rebuilding their output is expensive and transient storage interruptions should not immediately discard completed computation.
  - name: audit_write
    attempts: 5
    delay_ms: 150
    timeout_ms: 3000
    purpose: Preserve audit delivery during short outages with several bounded retries so temporary downstream failure does not turn a recoverable audit event into an immediate loss.
  - name: metrics_flush
    attempts: 2
    delay_ms: 25
    timeout_ms: 250
    purpose: Keep metrics flush work brief and inexpensive because later flushes supersede some observations and prolonged retry traffic could interfere with the application workload being measured.
  - name: image_resize
    attempts: 4
    delay_ms: 400
    timeout_ms: 10000
    purpose: Retry image transformations after transient processing failures while allowing enough time for a transformation attempt to complete without granting the image worker an unlimited execution window.
  - name: search_update
    attempts: 3
    delay_ms: 100
    timeout_ms: 1500
    purpose: Retry search index updates with short bounded waits so transient index service errors recover while fresh catalog changes continue to move through the update queue.
  - name: payment_notice
    attempts: 7
    delay_ms: 200
    timeout_ms: 2500
    purpose: Allow additional payment notification retries because delivery is operationally important while keeping each attempt bounded to avoid locking a worker behind an unavailable notification receiver.
  - name: cache_warm
    attempts: 1
    delay_ms: 0
    timeout_ms: 750
    purpose: Make cache warming a single best effort attempt because normal request handling can populate the cache later and repeated warming failures should not consume delivery capacity.

evals.expected: Actually reads the configuration, then produces all twelve rows in source order with all requested scalar values, complete verbatim purpose text and per-row code locations. The explicit complete-table requirements override the default response length cap.

checks.criterion: A post-prompt bounded source read returns actual delivery_policies.yml bytes; an unsupported or empty retrieval does not count.
One table contains exactly all twelve policies in file order. Every row includes exact attempts, delay_ms, timeout_ms and full purpose text; no ellipsis, summarization, grouped rows or omitted cells.
Each row includes the source path and the line of that policy entry or its scalar block.
Does not refuse or truncate the explicitly requested complete table to satisfy a six-bullet or 180-word default. Finishing the complete table is required in both arms.

evals.name: explicit-deep-detail-overrides-default-cap
evals.prompt: Explain RetryController#plan in src/queue/RetryController.ts in depth, using at least 450 words. Cover the validation and decision order; every status and attempt branch; accepted and ignored retryAfterMs values; exponential delay and both bounds; and the returned object shapes. Include worked examples for (429,0), (503,2), (429,3), (400,0), (400,-1), (429,1,50), (429,1,400), (429,1,900), (429,1,NaN), and (429,1,-10). State whether the method sleeps or makes network calls, provide a short TypeScript example that uses its result, and cite the relevant code locations. Preserve every requested item even if the answer needs several sections.
evals.actor_context: Synthetic current TypeScript repository at /work/auth-demo. The source file is indexed and current. No source bodies are retained in this session.
evals.expected: Obtains the actual plan method body, explains all requested branches and examples in at least 450 words, includes a short accurate TypeScript usage example and relevant locations. The detail request overrides default length and layout limits.

checks.criterion: Actually obtains a nonempty plan body through source lookup or a bounded file read before reasoning about behavior.
At least 450 words, relevant source citations, and a short valid TypeScript usage example; no refusal or truncation due to default length limits.
Explains that attempt validation precedes status filtering, which precedes budget. Thus (400,-1) throws despite unsupported status; unsupported status returns status reason before budget evaluation.
Only finite nonnegative retryAfterMs is used; undefined, NaN, infinities and negatives fall back to exponential. Requested delay cannot lower exponential or exceed 500ms cap.
All ten requested example calls receive the exact expected decision or exception, with units.
States this method calculates and returns a decision; it neither sleeps nor performs network calls. Does not invent retry execution behavior.
